definition.value: Needing attention or action without delay.

definition.rationale: A matter that worries someone narrows the entry to the countable worrying fact or situation and removes the broader needs-attention alternative. Collins noun sense 3 is direct evidence. Oxford worry noun sense 1 supports the semantic family only; its important-matter sense is not substituted.

example.value: I have a concern about the delivery address.
example.rationale: I have a concern about the delivery address naturally names one worrying matter. The countable noun is clear and distinct from a business, a priority, protective interest, or the verb concerns meaning is about.

difficulty.rationale: Accept editorial B2 chiefly from the exact Collins countable worrying-matter sense. Oxford concern_sng_6 cefr b2 is only related worry-noun metadata, not proof of an identical countable selected sense.

definition.value: A way to deal with a problem successfully.
definition.rationale: The retained definition selects a successful way to deal with a problem. Oxford and Collins problem-response noun sections support it; a chemical mixture and a puzzle or mathematical answer are not silently included.

example.value: The team agreed on a practical solution.
example.rationale: Agreement on a practical solution is natural workplace wording for a response to a problem. It adds no unsupported technical effectiveness claim and contains no chemical-mixture meaning.

difficulty.rationale: Accept editorial A2 following frozen Oxford selected solution_sng_1 cefr a2. Collins labels the selected problem-response sense B1+; preserve that difference literally. A2 is an editorial choice, not a conversion of B1+ or agreement between publishers.

definition.value: An established way of carrying out an activity.
definition.rationale: The retained definition expresses an established way of doing an activity. Oxford general-method sense 1 and Collins method noun support it. A surgical operation and particular legal or regulated processes are separate applications requiring their own review.

example.value: We followed the procedure for requesting replacement equipment.
example.rationale: Following a procedure for requesting equipment directly demonstrates an established method. It improves on the draft personification of a procedure explaining something, while making no claim that a particular organization uses this method.

difficulty.rationale: Accept editorial B2 from frozen Oxford selected cefr b2, its rendered Scientific research B2 topic, and fresh Collins general-method B2. The topic label remains distinct from the literal HTML attribute and does not approve research or clinical procedures.

accepted_projection.definition: An established way of carrying out an activity.
accepted_projection.example: We followed the procedure for requesting replacement equipment.

image.brief: A clear ordered workplace procedure for requesting replacement equipment.

review.notes: Proposed intact modern teaching unit, not a claim that the word lacks historical morphology. The method noun is borrowed through French from the proceeding family. A direct modern proceed + ure derivation and its spelling changes need stronger linguistic justification for this sense; keep the word intact instead of guessing pro + cedure. Source consultation was performed by an AI author; a qualified linguistic reviewer must decide whether this candidate is suitable for teaching. All review gates remain pending.
